text_en: Then Job answered:
text_cn: 约伯答复说：

text_en: “Indeed I know that this is so; but how can a mortal be just before God?
text_cn: 我确实知道事情是这样，但人怎能同天主讲理？

text_en: If one wished to contend with him, one could not answer him once in a thousand.
text_cn: 人若愿意同天主辩论，千个问题中，谁也回答不出一个。

text_en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength —who has resisted him, and succeeded? —
text_cn: 虽心中明智，力量强大，但谁能对抗天主，而保平安？

text_en: he who removes mountains, and they do not know it, when he overturns them in his anger;
text_cn: 他可移山，山却不知；他一发怒，山即翻转；

text_en: who shakes the earth out of its place, and its pillars tremble;
text_cn: 他振摇大地，使之脱离原处，地柱随之摇撼震动；

text_en: who commands the sun, and it does not rise; who seals up the stars;
text_cn: 他一下令，太阳即不升起，星辰即封闭不动；

text_en: who alone stretched out the heavens and trampled the waves of the Sea;
text_cn: 惟有他展开天空，步行海波之上；

text_en: who made the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the chambers of the south;
text_cn: 他创造了北斗和参（shēn）宿（xiù），昴（mǎo）星及南极星辰；

text_en: who does great things beyond understanding, and marvelous things without number.
text_cn: 他所作的大事，不可胜数。

text_en: Look, he passes by me, and I do not see him; he moves on, but I do not perceive him.
text_cn: 他由我身旁经过，我却没有看见；他走过去，我仍没有发觉。

text_en: He snatches away; who can stop him? Who will say to him, ‘What are you doing? ’
text_cn: 他若抢夺，谁能阻挡？谁能问他说：“你作什么？”

text_en: “God will not turn back his anger; the helpers of Rahab bowed beneath him.
text_cn: 天主一愤怒，决不收回。为虎作伥的，必屈服在他以下。

text_en: How then can I answer him, choosing my words with him?
text_cn: 如此我怎敢回答，我怎敢措辞与他抗辩？

text_en: Though I am innocent, I cannot answer him; I must appeal for mercy to my accuser.
text_cn: 纵然有理，也不敢回答，唯有哀求我的判官开恩。

text_en: If I summoned him and he answered me, I do not believe that he would listen to my voice.
text_cn: 我向他呼求，纵然他答应我，我仍不相信他会听我的呼声。

text_en: For he crushes me with a tempest, and multiplies my wounds without cause;
text_cn: 他为了一根头发而折磨我，无故增加我的创伤；

text_en: he will not let me get my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
text_cn: 致使我不能喘一口气，使我饱尝苦辛。

text_en: If it is a contest of strength, he is the strong one! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon him?
text_cn: 论力量，他强而有力；论审判，谁能将他传来？

text_en: Though I am innocent, my own mouth would condemn me; though I am blameless, he would prove me perverse.
text_cn: 我虽自以为正义，他的口却判定我有罪；我虽自觉无辜，他却证明我有偏差。

text_en: I am blameless; I do not know myself; I loathe my life.
text_cn: 我是无辜的，我已不顾及我的生命，我已厌恶生活下去。

text_en: It is all one; therefore I say, he destroys both the blameless and the wicked.
text_cn: 因此我说：都是一样。善人恶人，他一概灭绝。

text_en: When disaster brings sudden death, he mocks at the calamity of the innocent.
text_cn: 若天灾突然降下使人猝死，他便嘲笑无罪者的绝望。

text_en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; he covers the eyes of its judges— if it is not he, who then is it?
text_cn: 大地落在恶人的手里，蒙蔽判官脸面的，不是他，是谁呢？

text_en: “My days are swifter than a runner; they flee away, they see no good.
text_cn: 我的日月过去比跑信的还快；疾走而过，无福乐可享。

text_en: They go by like skiffs of reed, like an eagle swooping on the prey.
text_cn: 急急驶过，似芦苇船，如骤降攫（jué）食的鹰。

text_en: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint; I will put off my sad countenance and be of good cheer, ’
text_cn: 我若决意忘掉我的哀怨，改变愁容，表示愉快；

text_en: I become afraid of all my suffering, for I know you will not hold me innocent.
text_cn: 但一想到我的痛苦，我就恐怖。我知道你决不以我为无辜。

text_en: I shall be condemned; why then do I labor in vain?
text_cn: 我若是有罪，又何苦白费心血？

text_en: If I wash myself with soap and cleanse my hands with lye,
text_cn: 我即便用雪洗我身，用咸水洗我手，

text_en: yet you will plunge me into filth, and my own clothes will abhor me.
text_cn: 你却把我浸在泥坑内，甚至我的衣服都憎恶我。

text_en: For he is not a mortal, as I am, that I might answer him, that we should come to trial together.
text_cn: 因为他不像我是个人，使我能答复他，或让我们同去听审。

text_en: There is no umpire between us, who might lay his hand on us both.
text_cn: 在我们中间没有仲裁，可按手在我们两造之间。

text_en: If he would take his rod away from me, and not let dread of him terrify me,
text_cn: 但愿他的棍杖远离我，他的威严不要恐吓我，

text_en: then I would speak without fear of him, for I know I am not what I am thought to be.
text_cn: 我好能讲话而不害怕；但是如今我并非如此。
